name: Ichingo Chobe River Lodge by Mantis
desc: Nestled on Impalila Island in Namibia, Ichingo Chobe River Lodge is a tented lodge surrounded by breath-taking scenery, abundant wildlife, birdlife and ideal fishing conditions. The lodge features eight large air-conditioned Meru safari tents set on a secluded island beneath a riverine canopy on the banks of the Chobe River. The lodge is perfect for families and welcomes children of all ages.
